votes.motion: Close the public hearing on CRA Budget Amendment No.1 for Fiscal Year 2025-26
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed budget amendment consolidating multiple funding sources into the Disaster Relief Loan Program and the Commercial Development Loan Program, among other items.

votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of June 3, 2025 and June 10, 2025
votes.description: Approves the official CRA Board meeting minutes from the June 3, 2025 and June 10, 2025 meetings.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 14 of 2025, approving the creation of the Disaster Relief Program
votes.description: Adopts the Disaster Relief Loan Program Policy to provide immediate financial assistance to businesses and property owners who have suffered significant damage or destruction due to fire, flooding, earthquakes, or storms.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 15 of 2025, approving the first amendment of the Fiscal Year 2026 budget of the Salt Lake City Community Reinvestment Agency
votes.description: Amends the CRA's FY2025-26 budget by over $14.4 million, consolidating funding sources into the Commercial Development Loan Program ($9.4M) and the Disaster Relief Loan Program ($5M), among other items.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 16 of 2025, amending and aligning loan terms for Book Cliffs Lodge
votes.description: Modifies three existing CRA loans totaling $4.74 million for the Book Cliffs Lodge affordable housing project at 1159 South West Temple, standardizing them to 40-year terms at 2.5% interest with cash-flow repayments in compliance with the 2024 Housing Development Loan Program.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 17 of 2025, approving the amended and restated term sheet for NeighborWorks Salt Lake, with a legislative intent that CRA staff study sustainability requirements for smaller developments, with consideration for upfront versus lifecycle costs to tenants
votes.description: Approves $2.1 million in CRA funds for NeighborWorks Salt Lake for the Maltair Lanes and Stanbridge developments, including a waiver of Enhanced Energy Performance and Emission-Free Building Operation sustainability thresholds for the Maltair Lanes project, and directs staff to study sustainability requirements for smaller developments.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 18 of 2025, approving the Salt Lake Central HTRZ Interlocal Agreement between Salt Lake City and The Salt Lake City Community Reinvestment Agency
votes.description: Approves the interlocal agreement authorizing the sharing of tax increment between Salt Lake City and the CRA for the Salt Lake Central Housing and Transit Reinvestment Zone, as required by state code.

Sets the date of Tuesday, November 18, 2025 at 2 p.m. to accept public comment and consider approving CRA Budget Amendment No. 2 for Fiscal Year 2025-26, which reallocates funding from the Depot District Infrastructure Improvements Program to the Depot District Infrastructure Property Acquisition Program.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property and for attorney-client matters
votes.description: Moves to enter a closed session to discuss real property transactions where public discussion would disclose appraisal values or prevent the best transaction terms, and for attorney-client privileged matters.
Moves to conclude the closed session and return to open meeting.
